summary: NAFDAC is mopping up nationwide all products made and distributed by Europharm Laboratories, Jos, over marketing authorization violations. Lab tests found Linmoxyn (Amoxicillin) suspension at 13.9% and 18.4% API and Amoxicillin 500mg capsules at 48.3% API.
